description: Roof extension and single storey front extension (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The roof extension, by virtue of design, form, bulk, scale, siting and materials used would represent a dominant and obtrusive form of development that fails to relate to, or appear subservient to the original dwelling and would be disproportionate to the established character, form and pattern of development, detrimental to the visual amenities of the subject property and surrounding area. The proposals are thereby contrary to Policies D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) Policy CP30 and Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD8, DMD13 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The front extension, by reason of its siting and design appears visually intrusive, overly dominant and discordant form of development and out of keeping with the character and appearance of the property and the surrounding area, contrary to Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD8 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
